title: Defence — Key Milestones
summary: **INS Mahendragiri (F38):** 6th Project 17A stealth frigate commissioned, Visakhapatnam; 75% indigenous; built by Mazagon Dock.

items: **INS Mahendragiri (F38):** 6th Project 17A stealth frigate commissioned, Visakhapatnam; 75% indigenous; built by Mazagon Dock.
**General Dhiraj Seth:** 31st Chief of Army Staff, unveiled "VIJAY" vision.
**Malvan:** 2nd Mahe-class anti-submarine craft, 80% indigenous, built at Cochin Shipyard.
**GAGAN (GPS Aided GEO Augmented Navigation):** India's SBAS, operational since 2015; DGCA conducted first satellite-based commercial jet landing using it.
